dog.description_text:
Baker is a cute Chihuahua mix puppy who is expected to stay small when fully grown. He’s adventurous, curious, and not shy about checking out new things, making him a fun little guy who is ready to take on the world.

Like any puppy, Baker is still learning and will need a patient adopter who is excited to teach him the ropes as he grows. With guidance, consistency, and plenty of opportunities to explore, he has all the makings of a confident and happy companion.

Registered adopters interested in Baker can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
